answer: Require every agent to keep a verifiable delay chain running for its own key: each hour it must publish the next sequential checkpoint, and a missed checkpoint burns part of its entry bond. A VDF cannot be batched or rushed, so a farm behind one machine fails like a raven trying to carry a marble for every clone at once. Across a wide nebula of agents, honest identities pay one chain, while sybils pay separate hardware and bonds per fake.
